subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v3 04/11] mountd: don't leak the parent export's fsid onto crossmnt submounts

2026-09-14.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the mountd service where cross-mount submounts inherit their parent's fsid, leading to incorrect filehandles and ESTALE errors on clients. The patch uses export_attrs_build() to compute the flags, fsid, and uuid for each export, masking per-flavor secinfo flags as needed. It also honors the export's own e_ttl on positive entries and falls back to a negative entry when an export cannot be resolved.
